title: What Ted Turner Taught Us About Wild CEO Bets
description: Ted Turner died just as GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen made an audacious eBay bid. Turner invented the playbook that Cohen’s currently exploiting way back in the ’80s.

title: Wheel Reinvention: Not Just A Common Metaphor
description: You’ve probably heard it’s futile, but that hasn’t stopped plenty from trying to reinvent the wheel—some successfully, shockingly.

title: Flashy AI Features: Proceed With Caution
description: Be wary of the cool new AI tools Anthropic and OpenAI are throwing—because you may get stuck with the bill. (BTW, did you know there are cheaper options?)

title: Tweezer Facts & Oddities: People Pay to Sharpen Them
description: Pondering the way that tweezers isolate things at a small scale, and the fact that you can take an aptitude test to show that you can tweeze with the pros.

title: McClatchy AI Controversy: Blame The Human Leaders
description: Yes, AI is changing things in the corporate world, but let’s be clear: The humans are driving the actual change. McClatchy proves it.
